JOB TITLE:
Senior Supplier Quality Engineer (Bilingual Preferred)
JOB PURPOSE:
The Senior Supplier Quality Engineer (Sr. SQE) is resp...onsible for ensuring the quality and stability of incoming materials through supplier audits, quality control, and guidance. This role continuously drives supplier quality improvements and cost reduction initiatives to align with the organization's strategic goals.
JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Supplier Audit and Evaluation (10%):
• Complete the annual supplier quality audit.
• Qualify new suppliers by reviewing documentation and conducting on-site audits to ensure adherence to product and project specifications.
• Analyze, measure, and update supplier KPIs.
• Promote Improvement of Supplier Material Quality (20%):
• Analyze and track supplier quality issues, ensuring continuous improvement.
• Develop and implement improvement projects for critical suppliers.
• Promote resolution and closure of major supplier material quality issues.
• Quality Loss Transfer (50%)
• Lead and manage supplier quality loss transfer activities, including material losses, scrap, sorting/rework costs, production losses, and other supplier-related quality costs.
• Identify, quantify, and determine supplier responsibility for quality losses, and lead claim negotiation and recovery with suppliers.
• Establish and maintain a supplier quality loss transfer tracking log, including loss amount, supplier responsibility, claim status, recovered amount, outstanding amount, and closure status.
• Track and follow up on open claims, ensuring timely closure and escalation of significant or disputed cases.
• Analyze recurring quality losses and drive corrective and preventive actions to reduce supplier-related quality costs.
• Material Standard SIP, Material Inspection SOP, and Quality Contract Review (10%):
• Lead supplier documentation management, including material and general conformity certificates.
• Drive material standardization management, including reviewing material SIPs and inspection SOPs.
• Review and ensure the integrity of Quality Contracts and Technical Quality Agreements.
• Evaluate and approve changes in raw materials, processes, production locations, and other supplier modifications.
• Assess new supplier or material introductions and evaluate results for bulk material improvements.
REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATION:
• Educational Background:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field. Masters is a plus
• Knowledge and Skills:
• Strong knowledge of quality management systems.
• Proficient in quality tools such as 8D and QC methodologies.
• Experience Requirements:
• Minimum 3 years of experience as an SQE senior engineer.
• At least 5 years of experience in industries such as semiconductor, photovoltaic, or automotive.
• Abilities and Qualities:
• Bilingual Preferred (Mandarin, English)
• Strong communication and coordination skills.
• Independent problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
• Excellent teamwork capabilities.
• Proficiency in statistical data analysis.
PLACE OF JOB IN THE ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE:
The Senior Supplier Quality Engineer will report to the Supplier Quality Management Department and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including production, procurement, and quality management systems, to achieve supplier quality objectives.

Job Title:
Warehouse Operations Engineer
Overview:
The Warehouse Operations Engineer supports warehouse operations within Jax Power's solar manufacturing facility. This role focuses on inventory accuracy, efficient material flow, process improvement, and coordination with production and supply chain teams. The position supports the receiving, storage, movement, and shipment... of raw materials, production components, spare parts, packaging materials, and finished products.

• Ensure warehouse activities comply with company safety policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Support receiving, unloading, inspection, put-away, storage, picking, packing, staging, shipping, and production material replenishment.
• Coordinate the timely movement of materials to prevent shortages, delays, and production interruptions.
• Maintain accurate inventory records through timely ERP and Warehouse Management System transactions.
• Conduct cycle counts, physical inventories, reconciliations, and discrepancy investigations.
• Ensure materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, handled, and traceable.
• Monitor warehouse workflows, space utilization, inventory movement, and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities.
• Investigate inventory and process issues, determine root causes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
• Implement improvements that enhance safety, productivity, inventory accuracy, quality, and material flow.
• Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions, process flows, and training materials.
• Track warehouse performance indicators and prepare reports for management.
• Coordinate with Quality regarding damaged, rejected, quarantined, returned, or nonconforming materials.
• Collaborate with Production, Planning, Logistics, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
• Support warehouse layout planning, storage optimization, employee training, onboarding, audits, and safety inspections.
• Perform other warehouse operations and process-improvement duties as assigned.
Key Requirements & Competencies:
• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field is required.
• Zero to three years of experience in warehouse operations, manufacturing, logistics, inventory control, or supply chain is preferred.
• Experience in solar, electronics, automotive, battery, or high-volume manufacturing is preferred.
• Working knowledge of ERP and Warehouse Management Systems is preferred.
• Knowledge of inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, cycle counting, and material traceability.
• Familiarity with root-cause analysis, corrective actions, 5S, Lean manufacturing, and process standardization is preferred.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate operational records.
• Ability to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
• Ability to work effectively with warehouse employees, supervisors, engineers, and cross-functional teams.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.
• Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin and English is strongly preferred.
Physical Requirements:
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform warehouse-related activities throughout an eight-hour or longer shift, as required.
• Ability to work in a warehouse and manufacturing environment with exposure to varying temperatures, noise, dust, machinery, and forklift traffic.
• Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or move materials weighing up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Ability to climb stairs, access storage locations, and perform physical inventory-verification activities.
• Ability to wear required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
Place of Job in the Organizational Structure:
The Warehouse Operations Engineer reports directly to the Warehouse Manager and works closely with Warehouse, Production, Planning, Logistics, Procurement, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
